 2026 DI field hockey championship: Bracket, schedule, scores
 DI field hockey: 2026 selection show 
 Share 
 The NCAA Division I field hockey committee announced today the teams that will compete in the 2026 Division I field hockey championship. Click or tap here for the press release.
 Ten conferences receive automatic bids, with the remaining eight teams selected at-large — teams must have an overall won-lost record of .500 or better and complete a minimum of 11 contests.
 Here’s everything you need to know leading up to the 2026 NCAA DI field hockey selection show that will reveal the full 18-team championship field for the single-elimination tournament.
 2026 DI women's field hockey championship bracket:
 Click or tap here for the interactive bracket .
 2026 DI women's field hockey championship schedule:
 Opening round: Wednesday, Nov. 11
 2 p.m. | Fairfield vs. Wagner | ESPN+ 
 2 p.m. | Saint Joseph's vs. Vermont | ESPN+ 
 First round:  Friday, Nov. 13
 12 p.m. | No. 4 UConn vs. Lafayette | ESPN+ 
 12 p.m. | No. 3 Harvard vs. Old Dominion | ESPN+ 
 2:30 p.m. | No. 5 Princeton vs. Syracuse | ESPN+ 
 2:30 p.m. | No. 6 Yale vs. UMass | ESPN+ 
 2:30 p.m. | No. 7 Iowa vs. Duke | ESPN+ 
 3:30 p.m. | No. 8 North Carolina vs. Miami (Ohio) | ESPN+ 
 Second round : Sunday, Nov. 15
 Semifinals/finals: Friday, Nov. 20 and Sunday, Nov. 22
